title: Compare pipelines across stratified folds
description: You inspect fold-specific preprocessing and aggregate evaluation metrics.

steps.description: You create shuffled stratified folds and select training and held-out rows for each. Each scaler fits only that fold's training features.
You optionally fit PCA on the scaled training fold before fitting the classifier. You compute every reported metric on that fold's held-out rows.

steps.question: What does each pair in the returned metrics dictionary contain?
steps.answer: It contains the mean and standard deviation of that metric's fold scores. Each list receives one value per fold.

steps.description: You compare five-fold results with and without two-component PCA. The recorded macro F1 means are 0.8029 without PCA and 0.8098 with PCA, while ROC AUC means are 0.9207 and 0.9160.
